g.text: Interactive Educational Diagram • Learn Plant Biology

text.tspan: 1. Review the flower diagram on the left
2. Drag label tiles from the word bank below
3. Match each term to the correct empty slot
4. Use arrows as guides for each part

g.text: Hover over slots to see highlights. Each arrow points to the correct flower part.
• Petal: Colorful leaf-like structures that attract pollinators
• Sepal: Green protective covering around the bud
• Pistil: Female reproductive part (stigma + style + ovary)
• Filament: Thin stalk supporting the anther
• Ovary: Contains ovules, develops into fruit
• Stigma: Sticky top that catches pollen
• Receptacle: Base where flower parts attach
• The pistil is in the CENTER of the flower
• Petals are the OUTER colorful parts
• Sepals are GREEN and protect the bud
• Follow the arrows from each slot to the part!
Review the pistil location and try again!
